blocks.text: Group 2 metals dilute acids (halke tezaab) se react kar ke ek salt (namak) aur hydrogen gas (H₂) banati hain.
Group mein neeche reactivity barhti hai. Beryllium (Be) dilute acids se react kar ke BeCl₂ aur hydrogen gas banata hai, lekin us ki hifazati oxide layer is reaction ko aahista kar sakti hai.
Magnesium (Mg) dilute acids (maslan hydrochloric acid, sulphuric acid) se aasani se react kar ke magnesium salts aur hydrogen gas banata hai.
Calcium (Ca) dilute acids se bohat tezi se react kar ke calcium salts aur hydrogen gas banata hai.
Lekin sulphuric acid ke saath reaction jaldi ruk sakta hai, kyunke banne wala calcium sulphate (CaSO₄) bohat kam ghulta hai aur metal ki satah (surface) par hifazati teh bana deta hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Har reaction mein metal do electrons de kar M²⁺ banta hai aur acid ke H⁺ ions yeh electrons le kar H₂ gas ban jate hain. Agar banne wala salt na ghule (jaise CaSO₄), to woh metal ko dhaanp leta hai aur acid metal tak nahi pohanch pata.

blocks.prompt: a) In reactions ki equations likhein: i) Ca aur oxygen ii) Ba aur paani.
blocks.explanation: i) 2Ca(s) + O₂(g) → 2CaO(s). ii) Ba(s) + 2H₂O(l) → Ba(OH)₂(aq) + H₂(g).

blocks.prompt: b) Sr aur Ba ke H₂SO₄ se reactions kitni door tak chalenge, andaza lagayein.
blocks.explanation: Dono jaldi ruk jayenge. SrSO₄ aur BaSO₄ CaSO₄ se bhi kam ghulte hain (Table 17.4: 7.11 × 10⁻⁵ aur 9.43 × 10⁻⁷ mol/100 g), is liye metal par fauran na ghulne wali teh ban jati hai. Ba zyada reactive hai, phir bhi BaSO₄ ki teh reaction ko sab se jaldi rok deti hai.

blocks.prompt: c) Electron configuration aur ion banne ki buniyad par batayein ke Group 2 elements reactive kyun hain.
blocks.explanation: In ke bahar wale shell mein do electrons (ns²) hain. In do electrons ko nikalne ki ionization energy kam hai, aur yeh de kar metal +2 charge wala stable ion (M²⁺) ban jata hai jis ka configuration noble gas jaisa hai. Is liye yeh jaldi react karte hain.

blocks.prompt: d) Calcium aur barium ke hawa mein jalne ki balanced equations likhein aur in ki reactivity ka muqabla karein.
blocks.explanation: 2Ca(s) + O₂(g) → 2CaO(s) aur 2Ba(s) + O₂(g) → 2BaO(s). Ba, Ca se zyada reactive hai, kyunke Ba ka atom bara hai aur us ki ionization energy kam hai (1st IE: Ba 503, Ca 590 kJ/mol), is liye woh zyada tezi se jalta hai.

blocks.prompt: e) Group 2 ke trend ke mutabiq radioactive radium (Ra) ki density aur melting point ka andaza lagayein.
blocks.explanation: Density: Ca 1.54, Sr 2.64, Ba 3.51 g/cm³; trend ke mutabiq Ra ki density Ba se zyada honi chahiye (taqreeban 5 g/cm³ ke qareeb). Melting point: Ca 842, Sr 777, Ba 727 °C, yani neeche kam ho raha hai; is liye Ra ka melting point 727 °C se kuch kam (taqreeban 700 °C) hona chahiye.

items: M + 2HCl → MCl₂ + H₂: metal + dilute acid → salt + hydrogen.
Reactivity neeche barhti hai; Be ko oxide layer aahista karti hai.
CaSO₄ kam ghulta hai aur Ca ka H₂SO₄ se reaction rok deta hai.
